title: Willowvale Extension 1, Mbhashe (town only, approx.): five young men shot dead, one wounded, 6 Oct
summary: Police say three unknown gunmen kicked open the door of a two-room flat at Willowvale Extension 1 informal settlement, near Ematyotyombeni, at about 21:50 on Tuesday 6 October and opened fire. Five young men aged 17 to 2...
story: Police say three unknown gunmen kicked open the door of a two-room flat at Willowvale Extension 1 informal settlement, near Ematyotyombeni, at about 21:50 on Tuesday 6 October and opened fire. Five young men aged 17 to 22 died, four in the flat and one on arrival at a clinic, and a man of 30 was wounded (SAPS, Brig Nobuntu Gantana). Numerous 9mm cartridges and projectiles were found. Police say the motive is unknown; no arrests reported in the sources read. The Daily Dispatch visited on 8 October: some residents said they believed it was linked to a fight over drug territory, which police have not said. Mbhashe Local Municipality condemned the killings. The victims were not named.
location_note: Willowvale Extension 1 informal settlement, near Ematyotyombeni, Willowvale (SAPS, Dispatch). The settlement is not mapped; the pin is GeoNames' point for Willowvale town, inside the Willowvale SAPS precinct.
